restaurantName: The Library Champagne Bar at The Edwardian Manchester
bio: Experience pure luxury at The Edwardian Manchester, A Radisson Collection Hotel and enjoy an elegant Afternoon Tea at The Library Champagne Bar.  The Library Champagne Bar is a beautiful and modern space in the iconic Free Trade Hall decorated with original art and handbound books by French publisher, Assouline.  Savour a sensational Afternoon Tea near Deansgate, freshly prepared in-house by The Library’s pâtissiers. A unique selection of handcrafted sandwiches, scones and patisseries complement a wide variety of Champagne for an extra touch of indulgence.  Situated in the city centre's stunning Free Trade Hall, the Grade II listed property is the perfect place to enjoy the longstanding tradition of High Tea.
pageTitle: The Library Champagne Bar at The Edwardian Manchester
